newsitem.title: USA: Mark IV declares five pct stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: Mark IV declares five pct stock dividend.

text.p: Mark IV Industries Inc said Monday its board had declared a five percent stock dividend.
It said it will distribute the dividend May 1, record April 18.
It said it will pay cash in lieu of fractional shares.
"After distribution of the stock dividend, there will be approximately 66,300,000 shares of Mark IV common stock outstanding," it said.
It said the stock dividend represented a 20 percent increase in the dividend rate when coupled with the recent 14 percent increase in its regular quarterly dividend.
Mark IV Industries makes power transmissions, fluid transfer and filtration systems and components for industrial and automotive markets.
